species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 56°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 20–24 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 30 ft, cold below.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 56°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 20–34 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 30 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
